cases.name: count: a linear lineage: each bundle counted over its predecessor's holders; the reader that acknowledged b2 holds b2's holders
count: the first bundle is counted over every holder it lists: two of three do not make it
count: a later bundle over a strict majority of its predecessor's holders: one of three is short
count: counted over the predecessor's holders, not its own: h1 and h4 of b1's four are no count over b0's three (one of three)
count: an iat mismatch is Invalid on its own, and the bundle is counted on the rest: h2's statement names another iat, so h1 alone is one of three
count: the same with h3 signing at the payload's iat: two of three
count: a holder revoked with no bound leaves the live holders: h3 revoked, b1 by h1 and h2 is two of two
count: a revoked holder's statement does not count: h3 revoked, b1 by h1 and h3 is one of two (not more than half)
count: a statement a holder's bound voids does not count: h2 bound at b0, so its statement on b1 is void: h1 alone is one of three
count: a statement at the bound still counts: h2 bound at b1, b1 by h1 and h2
heads: version is prev's plus one: a bundle on b0 at version 2 is Invalid
heads: family is prev's: a bundle on b0 under another family_key_id is Invalid
count: recovery_commitments are keys exactly the holders: a bundle missing h3's is Invalid
recovery: a holder's own key recovery: h3's recovery key alone replaces h3 by h3b
recovery: a recovery that changes another seat concludes nothing (recovery_changes_other_seat)
recovery: a spent commitment concludes nothing: a second recovery under r:h3 on the first

recovery: concurrent with an amend under the same charter: both tips fold; h3 is out (the recovery removed it, and no addition of h3 has that removal in its past), h3b is in (its own recovery), h4 is in (added by h1 and h2, two of the fold's live h1 h2 h3b... over b0's holders the fold seats: h1 h2)
recovery: concurrent with an amend that changes the charter: the tips do not fold, and the holders are those common to them: h1 and h2 (h3b and h4 wait for a bundle that names both)
recovery: two recoveries of one seat, neither in the other's past (h3 forks its own recovery to h3b and h3c): contested, neither replaces the seat, and h3's seat stays as it was
recovery: until a bundle names both: h1 and h2 join them (over the holders common to them, h1 and h2), seating h3b
fold: two successors with the same charter fold: h4 (s1, by h1 h2) and h5 (s2, by h2 h3) are both in
fold: a removal on one tip folds out: s1 removes h3, s2 adds h5 by h2 and h3; h3 is out, and h5's count over b0's holders the fold seats (h1 h2) is h2 alone, one of two: h5 is not in
fold: two successors with different charters do not fold: the holders common to them (h1 h2 h3), waiting
fold: the seats fold too: s1 seats n2, s2 seats n3 (same charter): n1, n2 and n3
fold: and are common where charters differ: n1
join: a join of two tips, counted by a strict majority of each: h1, h2 and h3 are three of s1's four and of s2's four
join: the common holders' base (h1 h2 h3) would take h1 and h2 (two of three); each predecessor's does not: two of four, twice
join: the same rule whatever the charters: h1, h2 and h3 join tips whose charters differ
join: the wire: prev is the greatest version, least id among equals; naming s2 first is Invalid

join: a join inherits the union of retired keys: rc rotates h3 to h3b, and am (h1 h2 add h4) still lists h3; joining them, h3 is no live holder of am for the count, so h1 and h2 are two of am's three and of rc's three
join: and revives nothing: the retired h3 signing it is no voice (h3 alone with h4 on am)
join: the wire: a named predecessor in the past of another concludes nothing (s1 and b0)
join: a forked join: two joins of s1 and s2 under different charters are contested: neither stands, and a reader that acknowledged both keeps s1 and s2 (their fold, h1..h5)
join: two joins with disjoint holders (h1 h4; h2 h5) leave no hole: they are contested, and the reader keeps s1 and s2
join: a bundle naming both settles them, counted by each joined join's majority: h1 h4 and h2 h5
join: h1 alone is no majority of either join's holders
join: two joins under the same charter fold as any tips do: not contested (each dropped the other tip's addition, so h4 and h5 fold out)
join: three joins, pairwise differing: all contested, and the reader keeps s1 and s2
join: a bundle naming two of the three settles nothing, and is void with them
join: one naming all three settles them
join: a join concurrent with an ordinary amend on one tip (a on s1, adding h6): no contest; j and a are tips under one charter and fold
join: the settling bundle itself forked: two settlers of j1 and j2 under different charters are contested in turn, and the reader ends at s1 and s2, the same holders, never fewer
join: and a bundle naming both settlers settles all, by each settler's majority (h1 and h2 of three)
in force: per reader: a reader that acknowledged s1 alone holds s1's holders; one that acknowledged nothing, its anchor's
in force: the same rows, a reader that acknowledged nothing: the anchor, b0
anchor: the reader's anchor by the holders' thumbprints
anchor: no anchor: genesis_bundle_not_anchored
anchor: any other first bundle is void for the reader: a second genesis x0 under the family, and a bundle on it the reader acknowledged: not in force
S'': h1 and h2 sign s1 at b0, then b1 at b0 with h3 and b2 on b1, without s1: s1 is self-forked, and by T h3 (signed only b1) against none: s1 is void, and no reader holds it
S'': the same where h3 did not sign b1: the same voices on both sides, a tie: s1 stands, and the reader that acknowledged both folds them
grant: a root grant counted over the holders of the bundle it names, at a strict majority: h1 alone on b0 is one of three
grant: the same signed by h1 and h2: a row; for a reader whose bundle in force is b0, in force
grant: a later bundle re-scopes existing grants with no re-issuance: a grant under b0, read by a reader at b2 whose charter still carries the duty, resolves
grant: the line first: the same grant, not in the past of the reader's acknowledgement row, is behind its line
grant: the same after b2 drops the duty from its charter: the grant exists, and stops resolving
grant: a grant under a tip the reader's line is not on: a reader at s1, a grant under s2 (counted by h2, h3 and h5 of four) is void for it
grant: a grant exists only where its bundle's charter carries its duty: a grant of `infra` under a bundle whose charter carries none
grant: a grant made under either successor stands as a row: one on s1 by h1 h2, one on s2 by h2 h3
grant: signers who hold only s1: a grant on s1 by h1, h2 and h4 is three of s1's four
grant: the head rule: signers who saw s2 but name only s1 conclude nothing (they must name both)
grant: the seen bundles are derived from the grant row's own past: an acceptance edge naming s2 there, and the grant naming only s1 concludes nothing
grant: the honest holder's acceptance edge: h2 signed s2 and its node wrote an acceptance edge to it (k2); h2's grant naming only s1, with k2 in its past, concludes nothing
grant: the residual, stated: the same grant with no row naming s2 in its past stands (h2's statement over s2 is not ordered against it, so it is not read)
grant: and from earlier grants in its past: one naming s2
grant: a past that acknowledges s1 alone: the grant on s1 stands
grant: naming both, they are counted over the fold (h1..h5): h1, h2 and h4 are three of five
grant: naming both under different charters, over the common holders (h1 h2 h3): h1 and h2
grant: a grant is counted over its own bundle's live holders: on s1 (h1..h4), h1 and h2 are two of four, short
grant: where charters differ, the scope in force is what both carry: both carry the duty, so h1, h2 and h4 on s1 resolve
grant: and where s2's charter drops the duty, the scope in force does not carry it: the grant on s1 stops resolving

attack: RJ0: a removed holder's recovery at b0 (h1, removed at b2, recovers to h1x) concludes, a sibling of b1, which h1 signed: no bundle it is behind, so S'' does not reach it (the statement residual's bundle form); a reader at b2 holds b2
attack: RJ1: h3 alone joins b2 and ra (one charter): the join is counted over their fold (h3 and h1x), and h3 is one of two: refused
attack: RS0: h3 recovers, and the room grows on it to five
attack: RS1: r:h3 later signs a second recovery at b0: by T between the two, h1 and h2 built only on the first: the stale one is void, nothing is contested, and b3 stands
attack: RS2: h1 and h2 'settle' with a join naming b3 and the void rc2: a join of both lines is counted without the void bundle, over b3's five: two of five, void
attack: RS3: a third recovery at b0: void too
attack: a join naming a void predecessor concludes nothing, though it names the line the void one is behind too: s1 (void by T) and b2, joined by majorities of both
attack: a recovery is not exempt from S'': h3 signed b1 and b2, then its recovery key recovers it at b0; behind b2, self-forked, and by T (h1 and h2 built only on b1 and b2) void
attack: G1: removed holders h1 and h2 grant on b0; for a reader at b2 the grant is behind its line, void
attack: RJ0 read by both (ra acknowledged first, then b2): the fold of b2 and ra; ra rotates h1 to h1x, and b2 removed h1, so the rotation follows the seat out: h1x is not seated
attack: RJ0 by a reader that acknowledged b2 first: ra is behind its line, void for it
attack: a join naming a predecessor void for the reader concludes nothing for it: jx joins b2 and ra by majorities of both, and a reader at b2 acknowledging jx after b2 stays at b2
attack: RJ1 with ra under a different charter: h3 alone joins b2 and ra; one of b2's three: refused (only the per-predecessor count closes this cheap-tip shape)
attack: the mirror: b1 removes h3 (h1 h2), and a sibling recovery rotates h3 to h3b; read by both, the rotation follows the seat out
attack: a join naming both that seats the holder again is a new seating, by the join's own count, under the key its payload states (h3b): h1 and h2 of b1's two and of rc's three

attack: EDGE (the stated residual: a reader with no acknowledgement takes its first head from a member it trusts, CC 3.3.4): in the seizure world (b2, and the cheap tip ra under another charter), a reader with no acknowledgement is at its anchor, b0; h3's lone grant on b2 is not in its lineage and does not resolve
attack: G2: a grant's named bundles are an antichain: h3 and h4 naming (b2, b0) conclude nothing
line: G1: removed holders h1 and h2 grant on b0; for a reader at b2 the grant is behind its line, void
line: an honest old grant in the past of the reader's acknowledgement row stands
line: a grant naming the reader's own bundle in force is no grant behind it
